posts.title: Why Do We Write Software?
posts.description: On my way to work this morning I listened to an interview with Wendy Liu on the Dreaming Against the Machine podcast. Wendy’s path from a wide-eyed programmer to a successful software engineer with technology disillusionment resonated with me. Our paths had so much in common. posts.title: Nix, Flakes, and Decentralized Inputs
posts.description: I have been thinking for a few weeks about how sad it is that we’ve taken a distributed version control system like Git and forced it to be centralized in Nix. This is especially true with regards to Flake inputs. If a forge like GitHub goes down then nix build will break, even though the same repository may be available elsewhere.
